verdict.rationale: Missive ships a built-in AI Assistant/Copilot that runs long sessions with a session tab showing its progress (missive-docs-34, missive-docs-2). It creates drafts (missive-docs-50), composes, replies and translates (missive-docs-49), answers questions from the docs (missive-docs-3), and can be extended with MCP tools to act on internal systems (missive-docs-27, missive-docs-16). One caveat is that it requires your own Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini API key (missive-intdir-2). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the range of delegable tasks and approval controls, independent or hands-on corroboration, and an included model rather than BYOK.
